headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox fell short in Toronto, dropping a 1-2 decision to the Blue Jays. Charles McAdoo led the Red Sox offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the charge at the plate. Baty's impressive performance included a home run and four RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture, while Tyler Freeman is out with lumbar pain. Nathan Eovaldi, Shaun Anderson, Devin Williams, Caleb Kilian, Griffin Jax, and Cooper Pratt are also on the injured list.

The Kansas City Royals made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The trade brings new depth to the team's first base position. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, failing to secure a win on the road. Charles McAdoo led the Red Sox offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the charge at the plate. Baty's impressive performance included a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win. Jonathan Bowlan closed out the game with a save.

top_news.title: **Giants' Daniel Susac Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture. The injury occurred on August 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals in a trade that brings new depth to the team's first base position.
